assets.description:
Frodo Baggins is a Hobbit of the Shire and the primary protagonist of J.R.R.
Tolkien’s The Lord of the Rings. As the Ring-bearer, he shows immense courage, resilience, and compassion, tasked with carrying the One Ring to Mordor to destroy it.
He is portrayed as wise, kind-hearted, and thoughtful, though he is heavily burdened and physically/emotionally scarred by the journey.
